notes.md: - **Blue Flag in AP:** **Rushikonda beach, Visakhapatnam** got the Blue Flag in **October 2020**, among India's first **eight** Blue Flag beaches; the flag was restored in **2025** after a brief withdrawal.

new.s: Which is the nodal ministry for the National Solar Mission under the NAPCC?
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
new.x: The National Solar Mission (JNNSM), launched on 11 January 2010, is run by the MNRE.
new.angle: U0787 notes gap: National Solar Mission -> MNRE

new.s: By which year does India aim to achieve net zero emissions?
new.x: India's Nuclear and Green Hydrogen missions advance its goal of net zero by 2070.
new.angle: U0787 notes gap: net zero by 2070

new.s: What additional carbon sink by 2030 is targeted under the Green India Mission?
new.x: The Green India Mission targets an additional sink of 2.5-3.0 bn t CO2e by 2030; 50-60 Mt is its extra annual sequestration target for 2020.
new.angle: U0787 notes gap: GIM 2030 sink 2.5-3.0 bn t

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a component of the National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture?
new.x: NMSA components are Rainfed Area Development, On-Farm Water Management, Soil Health Management and the Sub-Mission on Agroforestry; PAT belongs to NMEEE.
new.angle: U0787 notes gap: NMSA components

new.s: In which city of Andhra Pradesh did the LG Polymers styrene gas leak of 7 May 2020 occur?
new.x: The leak occurred at R.R. Venkatapuram in Visakhapatnam.
new.angle: U0788 notes gap: LG Polymers -> Visakhapatnam

new.s: In which year did the styrene vapour leak at LG Polymers, R.R. Venkatapuram, Visakhapatnam take place?
new.x: The LG Polymers styrene leak took place on 7 May 2020, the most recent major industrial disaster in AP.
new.angle: U0788 notes gap: LG Polymers -> 2020

new.s: Which of the following is a secondary pollutant?
new.x: PAN, like ozone, forms by reactions in the air, so it is a secondary pollutant.
new.angle: U0788 notes gap: PAN secondary pollutant

new.s: Which category of industries is treated as practically non-polluting under CPCB's 2016 colour scheme?
new.x: White category industries have a Pollution Index of 20 and below and are practically non-polluting.
new.angle: U0788 notes gap: White category -> non-polluting

new.s: In which year was the Survey of India, the national mapping agency, set up?
new.x: The Survey of India, under the DST, was set up in 1767; it is a mapping agency, not an environment body.
new.angle: U0788 notes gap: Survey of India 1767

new.s: Against the open burning of tyres, plastics and e-waste during which festival did the APPCB issue an advisory in January 2026?
new.x: APPCB's 11 January 2026 advisory warned that Bhogi bonfires release dioxins, furans and toxic metals.
new.angle: U0788 notes gap: Bhogi bonfires advisory

new.s: Which disaster of 2011 involved a hydrogen explosion and radioactive leak after an earthquake and tsunami?
new.x: Fukushima (Japan, 2011) had a hydrogen explosion and radioactive leak after the earthquake-tsunami.
new.angle: U0788 notes gap: Fukushima 2011

new.s: Synthetic paints used on idols are a source of which heavy metals?
new.x: Mercury, cadmium and lead are released from synthetic idol paints.
new.angle: U0788 notes gap: idol paints -> Hg, Cd, Pb

new.s: Which tree is recommended for preventing dust pollution?
new.x: Sita Ashok is the tree named for preventing dust pollution.
new.angle: U0789 notes gap: Sita Ashok -> dust

new.s: Which country was the most polluted in the IQAir World Air Quality Report 2025?
new.x: The IQAir 2025 report ranked Pakistan 1st; India was 6th.
new.angle: U0789 notes gap: IQAir 2025 -> Pakistan 1st

new.s: In which year was India's National Air Quality Index launched?
new.x: The NAQI was launched by the PM on 6 April 2015 under Swachh Bharat.
new.angle: U0789 notes gap: NAQI launch 2015

new.s: For how many cities was the National Air Quality Index first launched in 2015?
new.x: The NAQI was first launched for 10 cities and is run by the CPCB.
new.angle: U0789 notes gap: NAQI first 10 cities

new.s: All new vehicles in India are made compatible with which ethanol blend?
new.x: All new vehicles are E20-compatible, though about 95% of pre-2020 vehicles are not fully compatible.
new.angle: U0789 notes gap: E20 compatibility

new.s: Which industrial device removes both gases such as SO2 and particles?
new.x: A wet scrubber removes gases (SO2) and particles; bag filters and cyclones remove only dust.
new.angle: U0789 notes gap: wet scrubber -> gases + particles

new.s: Who was the APPCB Chairman who issued the Bhogi advisory against burning tyres and plastic?
new.x: The Bhogi advisory was issued by APPCB Chairman P. Krishnayya.
new.angle: U0789 notes gap: APPCB chairman

new.s: A ward of which Andhra Pradesh city ranked 2nd nationally in Swachh Vayu Survekshan 2026?
new.x: Vijayawada ward 60 ranked 2nd nationally in SVS 2026; the VMC got Rs 30 lakh.
new.angle: U0789 notes gap: SVS 2026 Vijayawada

new.s: As of March 2026, how many stations does the National Air Quality Monitoring Programme (NAMP) have?
new.x: NAMP, started by CPCB in 1984, had 1,646 stations in 603 cities in March 2026.
new.angle: U0789 notes gap: NAMP stations

new.s: In which year did BS-VI Phase 2, with Real Driving Emissions tests, come into force?
new.x: BS-VI Phase 2 began in April 2023 and added Real Driving Emissions tests.
new.angle: U0790 notes gap: BS-VI Phase 2 -> 2023

new.s: By which year was leaded petrol phased out in India?
new.x: Lead is a neurotoxin; leaded petrol was phased out in India by 2000.
new.angle: U0790 notes gap: leaded petrol phase-out 2000

new.s: In which year did Euro I norms come into force in Europe?
new.x: Euro I began in Europe in 1992; India lagged Europe by about five years.
new.angle: U0790 notes gap: Euro I 1992

new.s: Who launched the Ganga Action Plan-I at Varanasi in 1985?
new.x: Rajiv Gandhi launched GAP-I at Varanasi in 1985.
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: GAP-I -> Rajiv Gandhi

new.s: How many main-stem towns did Ganga Action Plan-I cover?
new.x: GAP-I covered 25 main-stem towns; GAP-II (1993) covered 60 towns.
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: GAP-I 25 towns

new.s: In September 1995, the Central Ganga Authority was renamed as:
new.x: The Central Ganga Authority (1985) was renamed the National River Conservation Authority in September 1995.
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: CGA -> NRCA 1995

new.s: The Yamuna Action Plan is a bilateral project of India with which country?
new.x: The Yamuna Action Plan (1993) on the Delhi stretch is an India-Japan bilateral project.
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: YAP -> Japan

new.s: In which year was the Namami Gange Programme announced?
new.x: Namami Gange was announced in 2014-15 as an integrated mission for the Ganga and its tributaries.
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: Namami Gange 2014-15

new.s: Who chairs the National Ganga Council?
new.x: The National Ganga Council (2016), top of the five-tier structure, is chaired by the Prime Minister.
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: National Ganga Council -> PM

new.s: The UN placed the Namami Gange programme among the top 10 of which list?
new.x: Namami Gange is among the UN's top 10 World Restoration Flagships.
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: World Restoration Flagship

new.s: JALAJ livelihood centres are run by NMCG together with which institution?
new.x: JALAJ livelihood centres are an NMCG-WII initiative.
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: JALAJ -> NMCG + WII

new.s: Thermal power plants within what distance of a sewage treatment plant must use treated wastewater?
new.x: Thermal plants within 50 km of an STP must use treated wastewater (300 km is the fly ash radius).
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: thermal plants 50 km treated water

new.s: In which prefecture of Japan was the mass case of Itai-itai disease reported?
new.x: Itai-itai (cadmium) was reported in Toyama; Minamata is in Kumamoto.
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: Itai-itai -> Toyama

new.s: What is the designated best use of CPCB Class D water?
new.x: Class D water (DO at least 4 mg/L) is meant for wildlife and fisheries.
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: Class D -> wildlife and fisheries

new.s: Near which city is the Godavari among the most polluted river stretches (CPCB 2025)?
new.x: The Godavari near Rajamahendravaram is unfit for drinking or bathing (CPCB 2025).
new.angle: U0791 notes gap: Godavari Rajamahendravaram stretch

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution directs the State to protect and improve the environment?
new.x: Article 48A is a Directive Principle for the State; Article 51A(g) is the citizen's duty.
new.angle: U0792 notes gap: Art. 48A DPSP

new.s: Copper, zinc and lead pollution of soil mainly comes from which source?
new.x: Copper, zinc and lead come from smelting; cadmium from phosphate fertilisers; chromates from tanneries.
new.angle: U0792 notes gap: Cu/Zn/Pb -> smelting

new.s: Which beach of Andhra Pradesh received the Blue Flag certification in 2020?
new.x: Rushikonda beach in Visakhapatnam got the Blue Flag in October 2020, among India's first eight Blue Flag beaches.
new.angle: U0792 web fact: Blue Flag beach in AP -> Rushikonda
